recommendation.summary: S5 FD-passing process handoff with identity state transfer (new binary).
justification: the change is interface-level but not S6-patchable (github.com/go-chi/chi/v5.mALL: package-level initializer ran once at start-up; github.com/go-chi/chi/v5.methodMap: package-level initializer ran once at start-up; github.com/go-chi/chi/v5.reverseMethodMap: package-level initializer ran once at start-up; ... and 4 more); state schema is unchanged, so S5 with identity transfer is the cheapest safe choice

S6 blockers (7): github.com/go-chi/chi/v5.mALL: package-level initializer ran once at start-up; github.com/go-chi/chi/v5.methodMap: package-level initializer ran once at start-up; github.com/go-chi/chi/v5.reverseMethodMap: package-level initializer ran once at start-up; github.com/go-chi/chi/v5.Router: interface method set changed (itabs and type assertions are compiled in); github.com/go-chi/chi/v5.mALL: package-level initializer ran once at start-up; S6 patches functions, not data; ... and 2 more
alternatives: Kubernetes rolling update (loses in-memory state, needs surge capacity)
risks: no patched function has a context.Context parameter: S6 gives per-call (not per-request) consistency, so one request may mix old and new versions of the 2 functions
